> Eod · Alphalete · 2026-09-18

Source: `C:\TAG Marketing Claude\Alphalete Trenchless Pipelining\EOD Report 2026-09-18.txt`

Friday. Alphalete-only report. The .md and .txt files are two formats of the same report (the .md uses Problem / What was done / Result blocks; the .txt is a plain-text version with the same facts).

# Alphalete Trenchless
See [Alphalete Trenchless (Hub)](lib:brain-alphalete-trenchless-hub).
- Search Console duplicate canonical (4 URLs) from the Jul 17 blog move: site already correct; indexing requested and validation started Sep 17. Google takes 2 to 4 weeks.
- Rewrote "Trenchless vs Traditional Sewer Repair" (1,160 to 1,800 words): comparison table, CIPP vs pipe bursting, cost factors, Colorado section, 2 FAQs, 3 added keywords (sewer pipe lining vs replacement 90/mo, is trenchless sewer repair cheaper 40/mo, sewer line repair options 50/mo). Wikipedia swapped for 2 EPA sources.
- Hydro jetting service page: an old blog URL held 1,002 impressions while the service page had 32 ever. Repointed the old URL to the service page; removed a tracking parameter crediting visits to ChatGPT, fixed a mislinked icon, softened 2 overpromises, updated FAQ and schema; added 2 Scott-approved sections plus a Denver mention (852 to 1,135 words). Indexing requested.
- Keyword audit (GSC 7-day, 28-day, 3-month): no useful position #2 terms; 92 page-2 keywords, 28 relevant. Blogs hold nearly all visibility (one post 15,841 impressions); service pages almost none. Old pre-move URLs still hold signal (cast iron post 790 vs 49). Semrush estimates not used for decisions.
- Audit fixes: indexing requested for the cast iron post; what-is post now links to the process post so it owns "how does trenchless sewer repair work"; metas added to the how-often post (page 1, 0.7% CTR) and the process post.
- Meta descriptions: 48 of 48 blog posts now have one (up from 11). 37 updated, all 70 to 158 characters, unique, no prices, phones or warranty claims.

# Follow-ups
- Scott: confirm the cast iron branch-connection FAQ wording, the "18 to 24 month" jetting interval, and whether Aurora is a service area.
- Oct 14 to 16: re-measure and decide which post owns "pros and cons".
- Canonical validation completes 2 to 4 weeks from Sep 17.
